test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Identify the sentence from the passage which is in the passive voice:

options.text: "The metamorphosis of a butterfly epitomizes transformation."
"The butterfly inflates its wings with hemolymph."

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Passive Voice Identification:***

 
 
• In the **Passive Voice**, the subject of the sentence receives the action rather than performing it. The structure typically follows **Subject + Form of 'to be' + Past Participle (V3)**.
 
• In Option 3, **"The caterpillar's structures are enzymatically dismantled,"** the subject (structures) is being acted upon (dismantled) by enzymes. The presence of the auxiliary verb "are" followed by the past participle "dismantled" confirms it is in the passive voice.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: Incorrect because it is in the **Active Voice** (The caterpillar [subject] performs the action of shedding).
 
• **Option 2**: Incorrect because it is in the **Active Voice** (The metamorphosis [subject] performs the action of epitomizing).
 
• **Option 4**: Incorrect because it is in the **Active Voice** (The butterfly [subject] performs the action of inflating).
